title: Stock Market Takes a Breather: QQQ Topping Tail Warning Signal
speaker: Drew Dosek

macro_themes.view: Daily topping tail at 5.365%; a weekly close under 5.28% would print a weekly topping tail and yields should ease, helping stocks and gold.
Index charts carrying bullish measured moves if yields pull back.
Big runners (META) pull back; big drops (RTX, CW) bounce.

calls.reason: Still holding inverse H&S neckline after an 11:30 recovery; measured move 800.92 if 10-year pulls back; needs a confirming follow-through close.
calls.quote: It's still maintaining this pattern which does carry a measured move target all the way up here just above $800

calls.reason: Topping tail yesterday led to a breather; if 10-year pulls back he sees a push above 28,000 before selling returns.
calls.quote: I see a scenario where the NASDAQ can push above 28,000 points

calls.reason: Pulled back 1.18% after piercing 78.6% fib; sleeper-hold pattern pulled it down; bouncing at probable support.
calls.quote: now we find ourselves bouncing at probable spots.

calls.condition: If Friday's weekly close is at/below 5.28%, a weekly topping tail prints and yields should pull in over the next 1-2 weeks.
calls.reason: Daily topping tail plus sleeper-hold pattern; near a weekly topping tail.
calls.quote: high probabilities next week and the following are going to start pulling in ever so slightly on that 10-year yield.

calls.reason: Long lower wick back above 4,104 support; easing yields support a bounce to retest the bottom of the parallel channel.
calls.quote: starting to scoop up some gold for a potential bounce up to retest the bottom of this parallel channel at $4,384.

calls.condition: A push above the ~66.50 neckline voids the H&S target.
calls.reason: Still in bear flag with active H&S targeting 53.26, though a near-term reprieve likely if yields fall; bounced at 50% of channel from 2008.
calls.quote: That does tell me target could still push down here to 5326.

calls.condition: If BTC gets above 89,440 (H&S neckline), he becomes a buyer and sees >100,000.
calls.reason: Chopping since Sep 21 breakout near low of range; reclaiming 89,440 negates H&S.
calls.quote: That's where I'm going to start angling to be more of a buyer

calls.condition: Needs to close back inside the parallel (~89.31); breaking the channel bottom moves it away from the inverse H&S target.
calls.reason: Bear flag but holding channel support at 86.90; inverse H&S with 116 measured move and 78.06 neckline.
calls.quote: that does have a targeted measured move folks up here at $116.

calls.reason: Confirmed breakout; sold all BOIL into it; will rebuy on dip to ~3.22-3.25 for 3.60 then cup-and-handle 3.89.
calls.quote: I'll be looking to be a buyer on NAC gas with any sort of dips.

calls.reason: Nine weeks straight down, daily RSI under 20; aggressive nibble here or conservative support at 170 (gap fill + 50% fib) for a bounce to the broken trendline ~194.
calls.quote: I certainly would be interested in picking up some RTX for a retrace uh back up to the broken trend line roughly right around $194.

calls.reason: Weekly RSI 28.5 oversold at prior pivot tops; a pierce of 500 could give a ~$100 technical bounce.
calls.quote: that very well may be a nice spot for a clean technical bounce

calls.reason: Big blowout run now forming a bear flag; expect pullback to 690 then 668 channel bottom, which could be long entries.
calls.quote: So now we're forming a bare flag.

calls.condition: If a weekly topping tail prints Friday atop the 2-year channel, expect downside; otherwise next resistance 258.09.
calls.reason: Pierced top of a channel since 2024 but fell back inside; rising wedge; potential weekly topping tail.
calls.quote: that likely tells me we should be coming down on Nvidia.

calls.reason: Repeated hits on declining trendline with good consolidation suggest a pierce, next target the inclining channel.
calls.quote: near-term potential breakout on AVGO with an overhead cap of resistance not that far away
